subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Do the CI and security owners approve trusting these new immutable action revisions in secret-bearing, publishing, scanning, repository-mutation, and Codex-agent workflows after exact-head validation completes?
rationale: YAML consistency and partial CI cannot decide whether the repository should trust new third-party executable revisions across privileged security boundaries.

options.title: Approve after verification
options.body: Rebase, finish exact-head checks, inspect upstream revision provenance and permissions, then merge the unchanged pin update.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Land low-risk setup updates separately while holding token, publishing, scanning, mutation, and Codex-agent revisions for focused review.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Defer the grouped update if the privileged upstream revisions cannot currently be validated with sufficient confidence.

recommendation.title: Approve after verification
recommendation.body: Rebase, finish exact-head checks, inspect upstream revision provenance and permissions, then merge the unchanged pin update.
